query: My sourdough starter finally doubled in size this morning after I fed it twice a day for a whole week, I’m so excited to bake my first loaf of crusty bread tomorrow. I also just picked up that new indoor cat tree I ordered last week, and my kitten has been zooming up and down it nonstop for the past hour, she loves it way more than I thought she would. Oh, and I finally got around to watching that popular fantasy series everyone’s been talking about, the season finale had such a wild plot twist I didn’t see coming at all. But anyway, I need to request returns for two of my delivered orders. For order #W5490111, I’d like to return items 4579334072, 1421289881, 6117189161 and 4947717507, with the refund going to credit_card_3124723. For order #W7387996, I want to return item 5796612084, please send that refund to paypal_9497703.
